# JoyDeviceName

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Joystick](BlitzBasic-Joystick)

</div>


```blitzbasic
JoyDeviceName:String port:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `port` | In | Int32 | required | The port to ask, counted from 0. |

**Returns:** The name, or an empty string if no joystick has had that port.

## Description

Tells the name of the joystick on a port, as the system gives it.

## Differences

* This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
Text 10, 10, "First joystick: " + JoyDeviceName(0)
Flip
WaitKey
```
